      "step": 1,
      "text": "Put in a sauce pan {{ing_01|oil}}, {{ing_02|broth}} {{ing_03|finely chopped leeks}}, {{ing_04|coriander}}, {{ing_05|small tid-bits}}, {{ing_06|cooked pork shoulder, cut into long strips including the skin}}, have everything equally half done."
    },

      "step": 2,
      "text": "Add {{ing_07|Matian apples cleaned, the core removed, sliced lengthwise}} and cook them together:"
    },

      "step": 3,
      "text": "Meanwhile crush {{ing_08|pepper}}, {{ing_09|cumin}}, {{ing_10|green coriander, or seeds}}, {{ing_11|mint}}, {{ing_12|laser root}}, moistened with {{ing_13|vinegar}}, {{ing_14|honey}} and {{ing_15|broth}} and {{ing_16|a little reduced must}}, add to this the broth of the above morsels, vinegar to taste, boil, skim, bind (strain over the morsels) sprinkle with pepper and serve."
